full_judgment: 14. So far as possession is concerned, finding of the learned Subordinate Judge appears to be based on documentary and oral evidence. Exhibit 2 stands to show the plaintiff already got possession at the time of execution of the deed on 30-4-1976 from the admitted owner. The defendant Nos. 8-11 who are sons and daughter of the original owner also admitted plaintiffs possession and ownership in recognition to the unregistered deed of gift. It appears that khatian No. 68 has also been prepared in the name of the plaintiff and he has been paying rents for the suit land including other lands vide Exhibit 4 series. In a violation Miscellaneous Case the defendant Nos. 1-7 did not contest in assertion of their physical possession in the suit land. The plaintiff was previously granted temporary injunction in the original suit to protect his possessory right against the defendants. Moreover, there is oral evidence in support of the plaintiffs possession too.
